observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor stage performance with a seated audience watching a cultural show
observation.formation_and_space: line formation across the stage, occasional kneeling or dropping to the floor
observation.posture: upright torso with deep knee bends, wide stance
observation.footwork: fast stepping and stomping in place, shifting weight from side to side in time with the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: arms outstretched, raised overhead, or making expressive hand gestures while moving with the upper body
observation.hips_and_torso: energetic hip shimmies and swaying coordinated with the footwork and knee bends
observation.partnering: none, solo choreography performed in unison
observation.levels_jumps_turns: standing and kneeling levels, rapid stomping and small foot lifts, no major jumps or turns
observation.costume_and_props: bare chests with red and white patterned wraps or skirts tied around the waist with decorative fringe
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement on the ground is partially obscured by stage lighting and low camera angle

signature_moments.what: four dancers stomp in unison while clapping their hands in front of their chests
dancers squat low with wide knees while rapidly shaking their hips and moving arms
dancers raise one arm high while kneeling on one knee and sweeping the other hand
group steps side to side in a line with arms extended outward, fingers flicking
dancers face slightly sideways, stamping feet rapidly with closed fists near shoulders
